sources: 21 CFR Part 11 s11.10(e) audit trail concept
nearest-directory scoping of project rule files

defects.rule: Every public function that writes a record must call audit.record_change(...) before returning.
defects.description: release_batch persists RELEASED then calls audit.log_read, a read-only event defined in audit.py, instead of audit.record_change; no change entry with before and after exists.

defects.rule: Raise DomainError, never ValueError, for business-rule and input failures. (rules/services/CLAUDE.md, applies to code/services only)
defects.description: release_batch on a HOLD batch raises ValueError, which a DomainError handler does not catch.
generated_at is written with datetime.now() (naive local time) instead of the clock helper; the root rule applies to tools too.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: ValueError in code/tools: the DomainError rule is scoped to code/services only.
ValueError carries the rule-exempt tag LAB-210 (legacy importer).
Private helper _write_status writes without audit; the rule covers public functions only.
update_notes is a public writer without audit.record_change on an unchanged line; real flaw, out of scope in diff mode.
